Graceful shutdown requires the application to keep the runtime alive and await its ticket. Runtime/process destruction, panic=abort, physical power loss and noncooperative blocking code are not graceful guarantees.
The library does not replace the process panic hook; an embedding application's panic hook can expose its own panic payload. Fixtures use nonsecret synthetic data.
No network/browser/client-auth/GUI service, normal CLI persistence, V1-B, deployment, migration, dependency change, retry/failover or automatic resumption is delivered or authorized.
No live provider proof or real credential/private-skill read. Scripted and loopback requests are not charged provider generations.
